app.title: uavlink setup page
step.role.name: Role
step.preset.name: Preset
step.settings.name: Settings
step.precheck.name: Pre-check
step.apply.name: Apply
step.role.title: 1. Select the machine role
step.role.intro: The role is suggested from what was detected on this machine. Select another role if the suggestion is wrong.
step.preset.title: 2. Select a preset
step.preset.intro: A preset fills in all settings. Every value can still be changed in step 3.
step.settings.title: 3. Adjust the settings
step.settings.intro: Check the values. Fields marked * are required. The system is not changed until Apply is pressed in step 5.
step.precheck.title: 4. Pre-check before applying
step.precheck.intro: The system is checked and every planned change is listed. This step writes nothing to the system.
step.apply.title: 5. Apply the configuration and view the results
step.apply.intro: The changes are written to the system, then the whole system is verified.
role.cm5.name: CM5 companion computer
role.cm5.desc: The computer on the aircraft that connects the X25 flight controller with the ground control station (GCS) over Ethernet, Wi-Fi and the Internet.
role.vps.name: Relay server (VPS)
role.vps.desc: A server on the Internet that relays MAVLink between the aircraft and the ground control stations and also runs Web Admin.
role.vps.later: Apply is planned for a later version. This version allows selecting and preparing the configuration, not applying it.
preset.none: This role has no preset yet.
settings.ask_note: Highlighted fields must be confirmed or filled in for this preset.
settings.fix_errors: Some values are not valid. Fix the fields marked in red.
field.secret_keep: Leave empty to keep the current value
field.secret_generate: Leave empty to generate a value
validate.enum: Select one of the listed values.
validate.type.port: Enter a port number from 1 to 65535.
validate.type.bool: The value must be on or off.
validate.type.enum: Select one of the listed values.
validate.type.ipv4: Enter an IPv4 address such as 192.168.50.2.
validate.type.host: Enter an IPv4 address or a host name.
validate.type.iface: Enter a network interface name such as eth0.
validate.type.path: Enter an absolute path starting with /.
validate.type.cidr_list: Enter networks like 192.168.50.0/24, separated by spaces.
validate.type.udp_targets: Enter targets like name=192.168.1.10:14550, separated by spaces.
validate.type.source_list: Enter "any" or IP addresses / networks separated by spaces.
validate.type.passphrase: At least 12 characters: letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
banner.preview_only: WSL: preview mode. The pre-check runs and shows the planned changes; the Apply button is disabled.
job.lost: The connection to the setup server was lost. The page reconnects automatically; the job continues on the machine.
precheck.all_ok: All checks passed. Continue to step 5.
precheck.warnings: No check failed; {n} check(s) have a warning. Read the warnings before continuing to step 5.
precheck.some_failed: {n} check(s) failed. Read them carefully before applying.
precheck.armed: The X25 flight controller is armed. Disarm it, then run the pre-check again.
precheck.job_failed: The pre-check did not complete. See the messages above.
precheck.why_armed: The button is disabled because the flight controller is armed.
precheck.why_preview: The button is disabled in preview mode.
stepname.eth: Ethernet to the X25 flight controller
apply.props_help: An X25 flight controller is connected. Its network parameters will be written and it will restart. Remove the propellers before applying.
apply.props_required: Confirm that the propellers are removed before applying.
apply.no_x25: No X25 flight controller was detected on USB: the flight controller step is skipped.
apply.no_precheck: The pre-check has not been run for these settings. Run the pre-check in step 4.
apply.ok: Completed. The configuration was applied and verified.
apply.failed: The apply did not succeed. See the log and the check results below.
results.some_failed: {n} check(s) failed. See the verification results below.
results.warnings: {n} check(s) have a warning. See the verification results below.
x25s.title: X25 flight controller status
rollback.armed: Automatic rollback timer started: if the connection is not confirmed within {secs} s, the firewall and SSH changes are rolled back.
rollback.auto_ok: The setup page confirmed the connection automatically.
rollback.auto_fail: Automatic confirmation failed ({msg}). If the machine is still reachable, run "uavlink confirm" on it.
rollback.confirmed: The connection was confirmed; the automatic rollback timer was cancelled.
rollback.fired: The automatic rollback timer fired: the firewall and SSH changes were rolled back.
gcs.title: Connect the ground control station (GCS)
gcs.connect_hint: In Mission Planner or QGroundControl, add a TCP (or UDP) connection to this address and port.
gcs.signing.title: MAVLink2 signing
gcs.signing.intro: MAVLink2 signing is on: the X25 flight controller ignores commands without the right key. Telemetry stays visible without the key. Enter the signing passphrase in the ground control station (GCS):
gcs.signing.mp: Mission Planner: SETUP → Advanced → Mavlink Signing → ADD, paste the signing passphrase, save, then reconnect. Do not press USE.
gcs.signing.qgc: QGroundControl: Application Settings → MAVLink → signing key (requires a version with MAVLink2 signing).
gcs.signing.keep: Store the signing passphrase in a safe place. Without the passphrase, no commands can be sent to the aircraft.
qr.alt: QR code of the signing passphrase
qr.hint: Scan the code to copy the signing passphrase to a tablet or phone.
sheet.title: uavlink setup sheet
sheet.hint: A text file with the connection details and the signing passphrase, for printing or safe storage.
sheet.keep_safe: Store this file safely: it contains the signing passphrase.
done.confirm: Confirm closing the setup page and stopping the setup server.
done.closed: The setup server has stopped. This browser tab can be closed. Run "uavlink setup" to open the setup page again.
status.title: System status
status.not_applied: uavlink has not applied any configuration yet.
status.verify_none: No verification has been run yet.
status.no_backups: No backups yet. The system makes 1 backup before every write to the flight controller.
status.restore_confirm: Confirm restoring the flight controller parameters from "{name}". The current network parameters will be overwritten.
err.network: Cannot reach the setup server. Check the network connection; if the server has stopped, run "uavlink setup" again.
err.auth: Not signed in. Open the full link printed by "uavlink setup" (the link contains the access token).
err.busy: Another job is running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
err.invalid: Some values are invalid. Check the settings again.
err.forbidden: The server refused the request (HTTP {status}). Reload the page from the link printed by "uavlink setup".
err.role.vps_not_ready: This version does not support setting up the relay server (VPS) yet.
err.copy: Copy failed. Select the text and copy it manually.
err.qr: Could not generate the QR code.
